name: stack-first
description: Stack-agnostic dependency guard: consult the preferred ecosystem before adding a library and record every ruling.

interface.shortDescription: Consult the preferred ecosystem and record a ruling before adding any dependency.
interface.longDescription: A stack-agnostic dependency guard. A model-invocable skill runs a five-step tech-selection procedure against the consuming project's docs/STACK.md ledger, and a non-blocking install-command hook reminds you to run it. Ships zero ecosystem facts and zero project rulings — everything project-specific lives in the consuming repo.
